problem.title: Find the Lowest Leaf in a Binary Tree
problem.problemStatement: Given a binary tree, determine the leaf node located at the greatest depth. If multiple leaves exist at the same depth, return the leftmost one.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
problem.output: • Print the value of the required leaf.
